/- Prove that if $H$ is a subgroup of $G$ of index $n$, then there is a normal subgroup $K$ of $G$
such that $K\leq H$ and $[G:K]\leq n!$-/
theorem subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) 
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  classical
  set K := H.normalCore with hKdef
  have hKnormal : K.Normal := Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  have hKle : K ≤ H := Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  have hcard : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
    have : H.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := rfl
    rw [this] at hH
    exact hH
  have hne : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) ≠ 0 := by rw [hcard]; exact hn
  haveI : Finite (G ⧸ H) := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero hne
  haveI : Fintype (G ⧸ H) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let φ : G →* Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H) := MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)
  have hker : K = φ.ker := Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker H
  have hinj : Function.Injective (QuotientGroup.kerLift φ) :=
    QuotientGroup.kerLift_injective φ
  haveI : Finite (G ⧸ φ.ker) := Finite.of_injective _ hinj
  haveI : Fintype (G ⧸ φ.ker) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hbound0 : Nat.card (G ⧸ φ.ker) ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj
  have hK_index : K.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ φ.ker) := by
    rw [hker]
    rfl
  have hperm : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = (Nat.card (G ⧸ H)).factorial := by
    simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_perm]
  have hK_le : K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
    rw [hK_index]
    calc Nat.card (G ⧸ φ.ker)
        ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := hbound0
      _ = (Nat.card (G ⧸ H)).factorial := hperm
      _ = n.factorial := by rw [hcard]
  have hKpos : 0 < K.index := by
    rw [hK_index]; exact Nat.card_pos
  have hKne : K.index ≠ 0 := Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hKpos
  exact ⟨K, hKnormal, hKle, hKne, hK_le⟩
